items.name: 01-hero
items.prompt: Photorealistic interior photography, real estate photo, Scandinavian farmhouse style, realistic proportions, clean and calm, no people, no text, no labels, no logos, no brand names, high detail. Palette: white oak, cream, sage green, terracotta accents, natural daylight. A bright dining room with a rectangular white oak dining table seating six: two simple oak chairs with cream linen seats on each long side and one at each end, all chairs tucked in neatly. Plenty of open floor around the table, at least an arm's length from the walls on every side. A linen runner with a ceramic vase of olive branches, a simple paper pendant light above the table, a low sideboard against the far wall, a woven jute rug larger than the table. Wide view showing the whole table, all six chairs and the space around it.
